method: Root inspected all 123 decoded reference/recreation pairs across 21 sheets covering every command/game, both failures, life loss, instant replay, full boss descent, chute failure, sneeze recovery, ocean landing, CLEAR, salute and end. Final source changes after that complete review were voice performance/mixing and export only; root independently reread five current movie sheets at opening, catch, salute/replay, landing and ending with matching source/video hashes. Shared isolated character/prop/background models and generic engines are disclosed; original scene functions/movies/frames are not used as output.
audio_evidence: 21 exact fresh original input strings/cast specifications; Dot +2.5 semitones, host/dot original gain/pan and command onsets retained, host presence EQ and voice-room parameters explicitly recorded. Four full published command phrases freshly synthesized then independently word-timestamp-trimmed to the original spoken first word. Base ASR 17/21 literal normalized matches; four nonverbal Ah/Choo vocalizations remain ambiguous in base and small ASR. Fresh score 1198 notes, 803 percussion hits and 168 effects; music-rest spans retained with intentional Foley/guqin/heartbeat. Final 1436-frame AAC export -14.8 LUFS / -2.6 dBTP from fresh PCM, oversampled limiter and 40 ms startup fade; no original audio. No human listening claim.
comparison_notes: Complete 59.833-second seven-style astronaut microgame sequence reconstructed, including original failures/replay and full boss-stage ending. Generic engines and isolated source models/art are credited, with new scene assembly, choreography, fresh narration, score and effects. Fine contours, paper grain, particles, registration, spotlights, framing and fictional dimension values differ. Nonverbal vocalizations retain source inputs but have uncertain ASR pronunciation. Source-informed recreation, not a blind model benchmark.
